questions.prompt: Hash partitioning spreads load from one very hot key across many partitions.
How can an application split writes to one hot key?
options: Add a random two-digit suffix, spreading writes over 100 keys

questions.prompt: With document-partitioned (local) indexes, what does a query for "all red cars" do?
options: Asks every partition and combines the results

questions.prompt: With a term-partitioned (global) index, what's the cost?
options: Reads are always stale by a day
One write may update index entries on several partitions, usually asynchronously
